CHIEF DISPOSITION ON THE NFRD ANCHOR REQUEST.

The inherited selection of 99602baac56b1a5afad5359a5c4bd019f2281343 remains correct as the latest evidentiary NFRD lineage: exact aggregate court, full cross-platform gate, type-discipline evidence, and one substantive approval are present. It is not current main and is not a safe implementation base while its immutable reviewer is gone and the candidate remains pending. Do not create another child or choose 16c85d4 or 7c7858f3.

The three measured class anchors are accepted as a future successor requirement: NfrdBaseballSpec, VerifiedParticipant, and NfrdBaseballReceipt each recompile the external court and kill its named class-shape mutation. Carry them into the next reducer-safe current-main NFRD successor.

For NfrdBaseballCourt privacy, choose the record-and-limit option. Keep the refusal as a clean-build court and state honestly that a legal test-only dependency does not make Zinc invalidate the external compiletime macro after only a visibility change. It is not an incremental local guarantee. Do not weaken visibility, touch production, add an external compiler, or widen the assigned path to disguise that limitation.

No edit or candidate is authorized now. Park this anchor until the NFRD lineage can be recut safely on current main with active reviewers. This is a sequencing decision: film source, nomination provenance, output authority, and recall visualization remain ahead of an external diagnostic intake.
